suite: Contract List – Not Require Allocation (NRA) List

title: NRA List – Lesson Allocation (Require Allocation = False) Archived – Excluded from Active and Inactive NRA Lists; Restored – Reappears
description: Regression / control case - Decision Table - a Not-Require-Allocation Lesson Allocation is excluded from both the Active and Inactive NRA list sections once archived, via the same Archived_At__c = NULL filter shared with the main Require-Allocation=True list (suite 1291/1293, already covered elsewhere in this epic), and reappears correctly once restored.
preconditions: - Student A has a Lesson Allocation for Course A with Require Allocation = False, End_Date_Time__c in the future (so it currently appears in the NRA list's Active section). The tenant is non-Riso (NRA list is shown).
steps_actions:
1. "HQ or CM Staff opens Student A's Contact record, clicks the Course tab, and views the NRA list's Active section"
2. "The Student Package Order behind this Lesson Allocation is fully removed, so the Lesson Allocation is archived"
3. "HQ or CM Staff reopens the Course tab and checks both the NRA Active and Inactive sections"
4. "A living Student Package Order reappears for Student A's Course A Student Course, so the Lesson Allocation is unarchived on the same record Id"
5. "HQ or CM Staff reopens the Course tab and views the NRA list's Active section"
steps_result:
1. "Student A's Course A Lesson Allocation appears in the NRA Active list"
2. "The Lesson Allocation shows Archived_At__c populated"
3. "The Lesson Allocation does not appear in either NRA section"
4. "The Lesson Allocation shows Archived_At__c blank again"
5. "The Lesson Allocation reappears in the NRA Active list"
steps_data:
1. "Require_Allocation__c = FALSE; Archived_At__c = blank -> included"
2. "Archived_At__c = current timestamp"
3. "Archived LA excluded from getLessonAllocationByFilter regardless of requireAllocation value"
4. "Archived_At__c = null (restored)"
5. "Archived_At__c = blank (restored) -> included again"
suite: Contract List – Not Require Allocation (NRA) List
